K8 Cruft: questions developers ask

What is K8 Cruft? +

K8 Cruft is a Windows tool that finds the regenerable junk developer tools leave behind: node_modules folders, build output, package caches, old Python environments, logs and version-control bloat. It scores every item by how safe it is to remove, and anything you choose to remove goes to a 30-day quarantine first. It runs entirely on your machine. £24.95, one-time, lifetime licence.

What does K8 Cruft actually find? +

Nine categories of developer cruft: build artifacts, caches, package-manager folders such as node_modules, logs, Python virtual environments and __pycache__, version-control bloat, temporary files, editor and tool caches, and leftover installer output. Each hit is labelled with its category, its size and a safety score, so you can see at a glance what is eating the disk and why.

Is it safe to delete node_modules and build folders? +

Usually, yes: they are regenerable. A node_modules folder comes back with npm install, a build folder comes back the next time you build, a Python environment comes back from your requirements file. K8 Cruft marks these with a regenerable badge and tells you what brings them back. It still never deletes anything itself: you tick what goes, and it moves to quarantine where you can restore it for 30 days.

What is a crap score? +

Every item K8 Cruft finds gets a score from 0 to 100% for how safe it is to remove. The score comes from the kind of junk: node_modules and caches score 95%, because one command brings them back, and a .git folder scores 40%, because unpushed work would go with it, so check first. You always make the final call; the score is there to save you reading every folder name.

Will K8 Cruft break my projects? +

K8 Cruft shows every find's path and when it was last touched, so you can see which project it belongs to before you decide. It will never auto-delete anything. You review every item, you decide what goes, and everything removed goes to quarantine with 30-day restore.

Does it have false positives? +

In our test across six project types and three package managers (NVM, Scoop and Chocolatey) the final run had zero false positives: nothing flagged that was not regenerable junk. Your machine will differ from our test, which is exactly why every removal goes to quarantine first and your system files, dev tools and package managers are protected by a 3-layer exclusion system.

Will K8 permanently delete my files? +

No. All removals go through a 30-day quarantine system first. Files sit there fully intact and restorable with one click. Even after 30 days, K8 asks for confirmation before permanent deletion. We’ve all heard the horror stories about tools that nuked someone’s wedding photos. That will never happen with K8.

Does K8 send my data anywhere? +

No. Absolutely not. K8 runs entirely on your local machine. It does not connect to the internet during scanning. Zero telemetry. Zero analytics. Zero tracking. We don’t know how often you run it, how many files you scan, or whether you prefer dark mode. Your privacy is not our product.

Do I need to create an account? +

No. K8 has no accounts, no login, no registration. You download it and start scanning. A licence key only goes in when you want K8 to clean up. We don’t want your email address, your usage data, or your firstborn. Just clean up your files in peace.

What is your refund policy? +

We offer a 30-day no-quibble money-back guarantee. If K8 isn’t right for you, contact us within 30 days of purchase and we’ll process a full refund, no questions asked. Email [email protected] and we’ll sort it promptly.

Are updates free? +

Yes. All updates to your purchased K8 product are free, forever. Bug fixes, performance improvements, and new features within your product are all included in your one-time purchase price. No subscriptions, no annual renewals.

Can I install K8 on more than one computer? +

Your licence covers one active installation. If you replace your computer, you can deactivate the old one and activate on the new machine using the same key. If the old machine is gone, contact us and we’ll reset your activation.

Still stuck? Email us at [email protected] — real humans, not bots.

💻 K8 is a Windows desktop app (Windows 10/11). Please visit lilbuba.ai on your PC to download.
